tagline.en: Gulf swamp to Lake Michigan, along the old US 51 and US 66
tagline.zh: 从墨西哥湾沼泽到密歇根湖，循 US 51 与 US 66 旧线

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.zh: 路易斯安那州拉普拉斯，与 I-10 相接

end.en: US 41 (Lake Shore Drive) at McCormick Place in Chicago, Illinois
end.zh: 伊利诺伊州芝加哥麦考密克展览中心旁，与 US 41（湖滨大道）相接

en: I-55 connects the Gulf coast to the Great Lakes, and it does so by following two older roads. From Louisiana to Memphis it parallels US 51, the highway it was built to replace; from St. Louis to Chicago it occupies the corridor of US 66, in places literally reusing the old pavement as one direction of the new divided road.

The southern half is a low-country route: elevated across the Manchac Swamp, through the pine belt of southern Mississippi to Jackson, then across the Mississippi Delta cotton land into Memphis. North of Memphis it runs up the Missouri side of the river past Cape Girardeau to St. Louis, and then across the Illinois prairie through Springfield and Bloomington–Normal to Chicago.

It ends as the Stevenson Expressway, dropping into the city alongside the Chicago Sanitary and Ship Canal and finishing at Lake Shore Drive beside McCormick Place. Louisiana uses the southern section as a hurricane evacuation route out of the New Orleans area.
zh: I-55 把墨西哥湾海岸与五大湖连在一起，而它的走法是沿着两条更老的道路。从路易斯安那到孟菲斯，它与 US 51 并行——后者正是它建来取代的公路；从圣路易斯到芝加哥，它占用 US 66 的走廊，有些地段干脆把旧路面用作新分隔式道路的一个方向。
南半段是一条低地路线：高架跨越曼夏克沼泽，穿密西西比州南部松林带抵杰克逊，再越过密西西比三角洲的棉田进入孟菲斯。孟菲斯以北，它沿密西西比河的密苏里一侧北上，经开普吉拉多至圣路易斯，随后横穿伊利诺伊草原，经斯普林菲尔德与布卢明顿—诺默尔抵达芝加哥。
它以史蒂文森快速路的身份收尾，沿芝加哥卫生与航运运河切入市区，止于麦考密克展览中心旁的湖滨大道。路易斯安那把南段用作新奥尔良地区的飓风疏散通道。

en: The southernmost stretch in Louisiana is a continuous twin concrete viaduct on piles across open swamp between LaPlace and Ponchatoula — one of the longest bridges over water anywhere, and the longest structure on the Interstate System.

It was not the original plan. The design called for a viaduct as far as Manchac and a ground-level highway on fill from there north to Ponchatoula. Local objections to the environmental damage that would cause led the state to extend the elevated structure through the whole wetland. Construction began in November 1973. A canal was dredged along the entire right-of-way so that prestressed concrete segments could be cast at a plant across Lake Pontchartrain and floated in by barge, and the piles were driven far below the swamp floor.

The old ground-level US 51 crossing was kept as a frontage road rather than demolished. In September 1976 a barge struck it and knocked a span into the water, killing one motorist — who, as it happened, worked for the firm building the I-55 viaduct alongside. Repairs took three months instead of the six first estimated, helped by the construction crew already on site.
zh: 路易斯安那境内最南的一段，是在拉普拉斯与庞查图拉之间、以桩基架设、横贯开阔沼泽的连续双线混凝土高架——它是世界上跨水最长的桥梁之一，也是州际公路系统上最长的构筑物。
这并非最初的方案。原设计是高架只修到曼夏克，自那里向北至庞查图拉改为填土的地面公路。当地对由此造成的环境破坏提出反对，州方遂将高架结构延伸贯穿整片湿地。工程于 1973 年 11 月开工。沿整条路权带疏浚出一条运河，使预应力混凝土构件可在庞恰特雷恩湖对岸的工厂预制、再由驳船浮运进场；桩基则打入沼泽底部极深处。
地面上的旧 US 51 桥没有拆除，而是留作辅道。1976 年 9 月，一艘驳船撞上该桥，将一跨撞落水中，一名驾车者死亡——巧的是，此人正供职于在旁施工建造 I-55 高架的公司。修复只用了三个月，而非最初估计的六个月，得益于施工队伍本就在现场。

en: The corridor was in the federal plans before the Interstate System existed: the US 51 route from New Orleans north was included in preliminary highway plans in the late 1930s, and in July 1957 a 64.7-mile stretch of US 51 from New Orleans to McComb was formally designated for the new system. The number I-55 was assigned the following month.

Louisiana opened its first pieces in 1960, with bypasses of Ponchatoula and Hammond. Chicago's end came in the 1960s: the Southwest Expressway opened on 1 September 1964 and was renamed for Adlai E. Stevenson II exactly a year later, with a short extension east to Lake Shore Drive finished in 1966.

In Illinois the road's arrival meant the end of US 66. Illinois took the US 66 shields down in 1977, two years before the last piece of I-55 — the elevated section from Ruddock north to Ponchatoula — was dedicated by Governor Edwin Edwards in May 1979.
zh: 这条走廊在州际公路系统出现之前就已列入联邦规划：自新奥尔良北上的 US 51 路线在 1930 年代末就被纳入公路初步方案，1957 年 7 月，自新奥尔良至麦库姆的 64.7 英里 US 51 路段被正式指定纳入新系统。I-55 的编号在次月确定。
路易斯安那 1960 年开通首批路段，即庞查图拉与哈蒙德的绕城线。芝加哥一端的建设在 1960 年代完成：西南快速路于 1964 年 9 月 1 日通车，整整一年后更名为阿德莱·史蒂文森二世快速路，向东通往湖滨大道的短延伸段于 1966 年完工。
在伊利诺伊，这条路的到来意味着 US 66 的终结。伊利诺伊于 1977 年撤下 US 66 的路牌；两年之后，I-55 最后一段——自拉多克北上至庞查图拉的高架段——由州长埃德温·爱德华兹于 1979 年 5 月主持落成。

value.en: 940.06 miles across 6 states; longest in Illinois at 294.38 miles, shortest in Tennessee at 12.35
value.zh: 940.06 英里，横跨 6 个州；伊利诺伊州最长，294.38 英里；田纳西州最短，12.35 英里

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

value.en: $312,136 contracted in October 1976 to rebuild the span knocked down by a barge, paid in full by the federal government under an emergency disaster programme, with a further $300,000 approved by FHWA to extend the bridge's fender system
value.zh: 1976 年 10 月发包 312,136 美元重建被驳船撞落的桥跨，全额由联邦政府依紧急灾害计划支付；FHWA 另核准 300,000 美元延长该桥的防撞护栏系统

figures.source: Historic American Engineering Record, Pass Manchac Bridge documentation, Library of Congress

why.en: No agency publishes a route-wide figure. Counts are collected per segment by six state transportation departments on different schedules, and the route's volumes range from two-lane-per-direction rural Mississippi to the Stevenson Expressway in Chicago.
why.zh: 没有机构发布全线数字。交通量由六个州的交通部门按各自的周期分段采集；全线流量从密西西比州单向双车道的乡村路段，到芝加哥的史蒂文森快速路，差异极大。

label.en: Length of the Manchac Swamp viaduct

why.en: Road and bridge references consistently give the elevated section as about 22.8 miles, but the figure traces to bridge-inventory compilations rather than any published Louisiana DOTD or FHWA statement, so it is not presented here as verified. For scale, the FHWA route log records 66.09 miles of I-55 in Louisiana.
why.zh: 各类道路与桥梁资料一致把高架段长度列为约 22.8 英里，但该数字源自桥梁清册的汇编，而非路易斯安那州交通发展部或 FHWA 的公开发布，故本文不将其视为已核实数据。作为参照，FHWA 路线登记表记录 I-55 在路易斯安那境内为 66.09 英里。

timeline.en: A 64.7-mile stretch of US 51 from New Orleans to McComb is designated for the Interstate System in July; the number I-55 is assigned on 14 August.
timeline.zh: 7 月，自新奥尔良至麦库姆的 64.7 英里 US 51 路段被指定纳入州际公路系统；8 月 14 日确定编号 I-55。

timeline.en: The first Louisiana sections open, bypassing Ponchatoula and Hammond.
timeline.zh: 路易斯安那首批路段通车，绕过庞查图拉与哈蒙德。

timeline.en: Chicago's Southwest Expressway opens on 1 September; a year later it is renamed for Adlai E. Stevenson II.
timeline.zh: 9 月 1 日，芝加哥西南快速路通车；一年后更名为阿德莱·史蒂文森二世快速路。

timeline.en: The short extension east from the Dan Ryan Expressway to Lake Shore Drive completes I-55 in Chicago.
timeline.zh: 自丹·瑞安快速路向东至湖滨大道的短延伸段建成，I-55 在芝加哥段全部完工。

timeline.en: Construction of the elevated crossing of the Manchac Swamp begins in November, after objections force the viaduct to be extended through the whole wetland.
timeline.zh: 11 月，曼夏克沼泽高架段开工；此前因反对意见，高架被迫延伸贯穿整片湿地。

timeline.en: A barge strikes the parallel US 51 bridge on 13 September and drops a span into the water. It reopens on 17 December, the same day the first 8.6 miles of elevated I-55 open between I-10 and Ruddock.
timeline.zh: 9 月 13 日，一艘驳船撞击平行的 US 51 桥，一跨落水。该桥于 12 月 17 日重新开放，同日 I-10 至拉多克之间首段 8.6 英里高架 I-55 通车。

timeline.en: Illinois decommissions US 66 and removes its shields along the I-55 corridor.
timeline.zh: 伊利诺伊撤销 US 66 编号，并沿 I-55 走廊撤下其路牌。

timeline.en: The last section, from Ruddock north to Ponchatoula, is dedicated on 25 May, completing I-55.
timeline.zh: 5 月 25 日，自拉多克北上至庞查图拉的最后一段落成，I-55 全线贯通。
